## My Role

As Powertrain Lead, I am leading a 7+ member team through the design, analysis, and integration of engine systems including cooling and fuel, transmission and shifting mechanisms, and differential assemblies. This includes conducting weekly design reviews to align subsystem timelines and technical decisions across the team.

More to come.
